notes: Sasuke's kits (v9.6). Slot 0, Susanoo's bow, changes the look (the bow in his left hand in every state). Slot 1, the Mangekyo Sharingan, keeps his sword: its kit swings the sword wreathed in black flames. Arrows, the Susanoo ribcage and the black flame barrier are drawn by the game.

0.held: a glowing purple chakra bow in his left hand
0.wguard: purple Susanoo chakra flares in his left hand and forms a glowing purple bow, which he holds forward in a ready archer stance
0.subject: Sasuke, a young ninja with spiky dark blue hair, an open white kimono shirt, a thick purple rope belt and dark blue pants, holding a glowing purple chakra bow (Susanoo's bow) in his left hand
0.guard_pose: ready archer stance facing right, a glowing purple chakra bow held forward in his left hand
0.air_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, the purple chakra bow in his left hand

w0_jab: first shot of a fast three-shot combo: draws and looses a single purple chakra arrow straight forward in one quick motion, the bow staying in his left hand, then back into the stance. Only Sasuke and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w0_jab2: second shot: quickly nocks two purple chakra arrows and looses them forward together, then back into the stance. Only Sasuke and his bow are drawn: no arrows flying away
w0_jab3: finisher: draws a big blazing purple arrow back to his cheek, holds the aim an instant, then looses it with a strong recoil, then back into the stance. Only Sasuke and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w0_nair: air shot: turns in mid-air and looses a purple chakra arrow diagonally down in front of him, then back to the tucked pose. Only Sasuke and his bow are drawn: no arrow flying away
w0_sspecial: arrow fan: draws three purple chakra arrows at once and looses them in a spread forward, then back into the stance. Only Sasuke and his bow are drawn: no arrows flying away
w0_uspecial: Susanoo leap: purple chakra wings flare up behind him and lift him straight up, the bow in his left hand, rising the whole time
w0_dspecial: Susanoo guard: raises the bow crosswise in front of him and braces, glaring, holds that guard, then returns to the stance. Only Sasuke and his bow are drawn: no ribcage, no effect

w1_jab2: second hit: his eyes glow red with the Mangekyo, a fast thrust of the straight sword wreathed in black flames straight forward, then back to the ready stance
w1_jab3: finisher: spins once and swings the straight sword in a wide rising arc wreathed in black flames with a dark purple rim, then back to the ready stance
w1_nair: air combo: two fast cuts of the straight sword wreathed in black flames, one down in front, then a spin cut around his body, then back to the tucked pose
w1_sspecial: Enton Kagutsuchi: crouches, then lunges forward with the straight sword held level at full arm extension, pointing straight ahead at chest height, the blade wrapped in black flames with a dark purple rim streaming backward along it, then back to the ready stance. The sword stays level, pointing forward
w1_uspecial: rising black flame slash: leaps straight up slashing the straight sword wreathed in black flames in an upward arc, rising the whole time
w1_dspecial: Enton barrier: glares with the Mangekyo Sharingan, one hand raised beside his eye, braces, holds, then returns to the stance. Only Sasuke is drawn: no flames, no effect
